outcome: Causes of repeat hospitalization (pneumonia, sepsis, gastroenteritis, severe anemia)
cohort: The study included 131 live-born neonates with gestation <32 weeks or birth weight <1500 g born at a level-III NICU.
finding: The incidence of repeat-hospitalization was 16%, primarily within 2 months of discharge due to infections, with lower socioeconomic status significantly associated with repeat-hospitalization.
